objectives: Decode taught sn-words by mapping graphemes from left to right.
Blend the sn onset with the vowel and ending.
Distinguish sn from other taught consonant blends.
Reread to repair a missed grapheme and check the complete word.

definitions.definition: A letter or letter group representing a speech sound.
Use grapheme-sound knowledge to read a written word.
Notice and repair an error using sound and print evidence.

workedExamples.solution: Map s-n-i-p, blend, and reread snip.
Keep s and n in order, then map a and p.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner reads snap as sap.
workedExamples.solution: Return to n after s and decode each grapheme.

activities.name: Model, practise, explain, and check.
steps: Review the target skill and a worked example.
Complete one example with guidance and explain the evidence.
Reread or recheck and repair any mismatch.

steps: Review a sample response with a target-skill error.
Identify the sound, grapheme, or evidence that does not match.
Repair the response and explain why.
Complete a fresh item without the model or answer key.
